knowledge_gaps: The proposal changes representation, loss and sampling simultaneously. Without controlled ablations, gains cannot be attributed to attribute sensitivity or the curriculum. Originality and potential ratings remain speculative.

Reproduction requires tokenization rules, vocabulary limits, text truncation, missing-text handling, residual scaling, normalization and temperature, warm-start duration, neighbor construction, sampling probabilities and a search plan within 43,200 GPU-seconds.

Text-near items may be relevant alternatives rather than useful negatives. Excluding observed positives cannot eliminate false negatives, and pooled tokens may lose connector direction, number-unit relationships and other decisive attributes.

Diagnostics must examine the joint ID-plus-text representation and actual scoring function. Near-zero mean cosine similarity does not rule out low-dimensional collapse, and training-position margins do not establish held-out ranking performance.

follow_up_queries.reason: Establish a reproducible objective and sampling curriculum, including false-negative risks and computational cost.
follow_up_queries.query: For HSTU sequential recommendation with L2-normalized sampled-softmax scores, what reproducible implementations compare 128 uniform negatives against uniform warm-start followed by stochastic text-neighbor negatives? Specify temperature, per-position versus shared negative pools, duplicate handling, curriculum schedules, and when proposal correction is justified for user-filtered mixtures sampled without replacement. Use no pretrained models or extra datasets.

follow_up_queries.reason: Determine whether a lightweight text encoder can preserve the specific attributes motivating the proposal and clarify implementation difficulty.
follow_up_queries.query: In sequential recommendation trained from scratch using only item titles and descriptions, how do pooled token residuals compare with small order-sensitive text encoders for preserving model numbers, number-unit pairs, connector direction and recording formats? Seek reproducible tokenization, vocabulary, missing-text, residual-gating and normalization choices, plus evidence about false negatives from text-neighbor sampling.

follow_up_queries.reason: Separate component effects and shortcut learning from improvements supported by the fixed validation benchmark.
follow_up_queries.query: What controlled ablations and diagnostics distinguish genuine gains from text features, normalized sampled softmax and hard-negative curricula in single-model sequential recommendation? Consider a fixed benchmark with four Amazon categories, 200 validation users per category, 99 sampled negatives, macro HR@10, seed 42 and a 43,200 GPU-second budget. Include validation-selection bias, popularity and text-length shortcuts, effective-rank diagnostics, and paired user-level uncertainty without accessing test labels.
